measurements.notes: Actual transaction: $33M for 1,200 acres (May 2024) = ~$27,500/ha. This is a real arms-length sale price post-entitlement, not a comparable — unusually good evidence for this factor, though still Tier C since it was read from press coverage rather than a parsed deed record.

measurements.name: Accelerator export control exposure
measurements.question: Can the intended compute legally be installed and operated here?
measurements.notes: US domestic deployment. Advanced accelerators may be installed and operated at a US site without export licensing; the controls govern export and re-export, not domestic use. Rule set checked 2026-09-03 — this is the fastest-moving input in the framework and must be re-verified per analysis.

gates.reason: Substation available capacity is unknown — the most common cause of late-stage project failure. Verify with the utility before committing capital.

gates.name: Sufficient contiguous developable land
gates.reason: 1257 ha contiguous developable area (computed upper bound).

measurements.name: Transmission line proximity
measurements.question: Distance to the nearest transmission line of sufficient voltage to serve target load.
measurements.notes: 400 kV line at 5.3 km; 136 line(s) at or above 230 kV within 60 km. Proximity is not capacity — read with pwr.substation_headroom.

measurements.name: On-site generation potential
measurements.question: Can the site self-supply or bridge with on-site generation?
measurements.notes: Composite: gas pipeline not found km, GHI 5.16 kWh/m2/day (35% weight). Wind and land-for-generation components not yet implemented — index is therefore conservative. Solar/wind cannot firm a data center load; counted here only for a hybrid or bridging strategy.

measurements.name: Wet-bulb temperature profile
measurements.question: How many hours per year exceed the free-cooling wet-bulb threshold?
measurements.notes: Design wet-bulb (0.4% exceedance) 27.5 C; mean 22.5 C. Computed from 10 yr of ERA5 hourly reanalysis via Stull (2011).

measurements.name: Reclaimed water availability
measurements.question: Is treated effluent available at sufficient volume and acceptable distance?
measurements.notes: Distance only — treated flow capacity must be confirmed with the operator. Reclaimed water is usually the highest score-per-dollar water intervention available: it neutralizes most community opposition and is often cheaper than potable.

measurements.name: Dry-bulb temperature profile and free-cooling hours
measurements.question: How many hours per year permit free (economizer) cooling?
measurements.notes: 1498 h/yr below 24.0 C. Design dry-bulb 39.6 C. Indicative PUE 1.282 — a screening proxy, not a CFD-grade model.

measurements.name: Extreme heat trend to 2050
measurements.question: How much does design-day temperature rise over the asset life?
measurements.notes: MODELED, NOT PROJECTED: linear extrapolation of the observed 30-year trend in annual design-day temperature (+0.140 C/yr). This is a placeholder for NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 and should not be cited as a climate projection.

measurements.name: Terrain slope
measurements.question: Mean and 90th-percentile slope across the developable area.
measurements.notes: mapzen DEM, 5x5 grid over 2.0 km. Mean slope 0.5%, p90 0.8%, relief 37 m. Below 2% is essentially free; earthwork cost rises roughly quadratically above that for a large flat-pad campus.

measurements.name: Contiguous developable area
measurements.question: Largest contiguous buildable area available at the site.
measurements.notes: SCREENING ESTIMATE ONLY. suburban (271 buildings/km2) within 5.0 km; assumed 16% developable. This is an upper bound on physically developable land and a much looser upper bound on ACQUIRABLE land — parcel fragmentation typically cuts it by half or more. Confirm against cadastral data before any decision.

measurements.name: Brownfield and retired-asset opportunity
measurements.question: Is this a retired industrial or generation site with reusable infrastructure?
measurements.notes: 67 industrial land parcel(s) nearby.

measurements.name: Internet exchange and cloud on-ramp proximity
measurements.question: Network distance to the nearest significant IXP or cloud on-ramp.
measurements.notes: Nearest interconnection facility 'Nxtra Data Mumbai DC 3' at 2.1 km; 53 facilities within 100 km. Weight this near zero for a training campus — over-weighting it biases site selection toward expensive metro land.

measurements.name: Carrier availability
measurements.question: How many distinct network operators can deliver service on site?
measurements.notes: 936 network presences across 49 facilities within 50 km. Network presences at carrier-neutral facilities are a proxy for carrier availability, not a direct count of carriers able to serve this parcel.

measurements.name: Long-haul fiber proximity
measurements.question: Distance to the nearest long-haul fiber route.
measurements.notes: OSM telecom route coverage is sparse and inconsistent worldwide. Tier C even when a route is found. Confirm with carriers or a paid route dataset.

measurements.name: Residential proximity and noise exposure
measurements.question: How many residences fall within the noise-relevant buffer?
measurements.notes: 214 estimated dwellings from 26 OSM residential features within 1.0 km. Apartment blocks estimated at 4 units/level. Noise from chillers and generator testing is the most common specific complaint in data center opposition — distance is the cheapest mitigation.

measurements.name: Organized opposition risk

measurements.notes: Hanover County Board of Supervisors REJECTED the 430-acre Mountain Road Technology Park 4-3 in May 2026 after months of organized resident opposition on water use, environment, traffic and noise. A split denial against mobilized residents is the strongest negative signal this factor captures.

measurements.notes: Required both a conditional use permit and rezoning; both were denied. The entitlement pathway is demonstrably contested in this specific corridor, as distinct from the same county's Beaverdam district where the same developer was approved unanimously.

hyperscale_training.label: Hyperscale AI training campus
hyperscale_training.description: Large-scale model training. Latency-insensitive, power-dominated, needs enormous contiguous land and a multi-hundred-megawatt power path. This is the profile most 2025-2030 AI capex targets.

inference_edge.label: Inference and edge serving
inference_edge.description: User-facing inference. Latency-critical, modest power, must be near demand. Land and power price matter far less; connectivity and metro proximity dominate.

retrofit_colo.label: Retrofit / colocation conversion
retrofit_colo.description: Converting existing industrial shells or upgrading legacy colo to AI-capable density. Constrained by existing structure, floor loading, and power feed.
